content: Řixḍaret n sebɛa imsexxaren n řmuminin
Deg wussan nni, řami tuɣa ktaren imeḥḍaren aṭṭas, aqa imeḥḍaren inni ɣarsen iřes n Iyunaniyyen ɛeksen inni ɣarsen iřes n Tɛibranit minzi tijjař nsen farrḍen daysent di tsexxart n zzad n kuř ass.
S uya řaɣan tenɛac n rrusul x marra agraw n imeḥḍaren maḥend ad munen, nnan asen: “War iɛeddeř ad nsexxar ṭṭwabeř i macca am nᵉttejja deg Wawař n AREBBI.
Arzum xenni, a aytma, u xḍarem sebɛa n yeryazen zzaywem inni ɣar teǧa cchadet tecna, ccuren s Arruḥ n SIDI d tiɣit, uca neccin ad ten nkellef xenni s tmesřact-a.
Maca neccin ad neṣbar di tẓaǧit u di tsexxart n Wawař.”

Iɛjeb wawař-a i marra řɣaci uca nitni ixḍaren Stifanus, ijj n weryaz iccuren s l’iman d Arruḥ Iqeddsen, xenni Filippus d Pruxurus d Nikanur d Timun d Parminas d Nikulas, ijj n umɛacar n ddin n Wudayen zi Antiyuxiya.
Ssbedden ten qibač i rrusul uca, awarni řami ẓẓuǧen, ssarsen xasen ifassen nsen.
Tuɣa Awař n AREBBI iggam u řqedd n imeḥḍaren di Urcalim tuɣa imeqqar aṭṭas. Ijj n ubarru d ameqqran n Wudayen iṭaɛ i l’iman.
Stifanus, iccur s arḍa d jjehd, tuɣa ittegg řeɛřamat d řeɛjayeb mɣarent jar řgens.
Kkaren yeryazen zi temzida umi qqaren ‘Alibertinu’, iryazen zi Qayrawan d Iskandariyya, uřa zi Kilikiya d Asiya, uca nitni tuɣa ttqacaḥen Stifanus.
Maca war zemmaren ad ɛeksen tiɣit d Arruḥ i zzayes tuɣa issawař.
Řexdenni ssekken iryazen, ɛarrnen ten maḥend ad inin: “Aqa nesřa asen ssawařen s wawařen iceqqfen di Musa u di AREBBI!”
Aqa ssɣewwɣen řgens d imɣaren n řgens d imseřmaden n idlisen uca umi xas dd-dduqqzen, ṭṭfen t, nedhen t ɣar Jmaɛet Tameqqrant.
Ggin řechud issxarriqen, inni innan: “Bnadem-a war issbeddi ad iceqqef di Ccariɛa u deg wemcan-a iqeddsen,
minzi nesřa as iqqar belli Yasuɛ Nnaṣiri wanita ad yareddeǧ amcan-a, ad ibeddeř ṭṭbayeɛ i d aneɣ iwca Musa.”
Marra inni tuɣa ɣar iǧa řkursi di Jmaɛet Tameqqrant, ḥekkaren dayes u ẓrin aɣembub nnes am uɣembub n ijj n lmalak.

footnotes.text: Alibertinu- iwdan qqaren belli Ilibirtiniyyen d ca n Israiliyyen i tuɣa ḥebbsen-ten Irumaniyyen iwyen ten ɣar tendint n Ruma. Menbaɛd ḍeȓqen-asen-dd, ssufɣen-ten zi Ruma, uca ɛeqben-dd ɣar Israil d imucan nneɣni. (Řex. 6:9).
